outcome: Decision-making process for mode of delivery
cohort: 17 pregnant women with a prior C-section who were deemed by their attending obstetrician to be candidates for a trial of labor
finding: While many participants felt they made the decision regarding mode of delivery, the majority who chose TOLAC ultimately underwent a C-section due to complications during late pregnancy or labor.
mod_finding: Of the 10 participants that decided TOLAC, 8 ended up having a C-section, and of the 7 patients that had planned an ERCD, 1 ended up having a vaginal delivery.
